description: This file contains abstract test cases for verifying the registration and handling of event classes in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes setup for classpath scanning, checks for proper annotation of event classes, and ensures that events are registered and serializable correctly.

classes.name: GlobalEventRegistryTestCases
classes.description: Abstract class providing common test scenarios for verifying event registration, annotation, and serialization in the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the list of JSON Parsable events annotated classes from the classpath before each test.

methods.name: sampleCheckForEventFromEachModule
methods.description: Test to verify that all modules containing events are present in the classpath.

methods.name: ensureSamplesAreComplete
methods.description: Test to verify that the sample classes cover all packages of annotated events.

methods.name: getPackagesDistinct
methods.description: Helper method to extract distinct packages from a collection of classes.

methods.name: allEventsRegistered
methods.description: Test to ensure all subclasses of Event are annotated with @JsonParsableEvent.

methods.name: allRegisteredEventsContainAMethodToParseFromJson
methods.description: Test to verify that each JSON Parsable Event class contains a method to parse the event from JSON.

methods.name: assertAnnotationIsValid
methods.description: Helper to validate the annotation's method name matches an existing method.

methods.name: getEventSubclasses
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve all concrete subclasses of Event.
